note: Root (2026-11-21): Filed under כתנ: the tunic is named for its cloth, linen, which is Arabic كَتَّانٌ, كَتَنٌ (Lane p. 2998) and Akkadian kitû, kitinnû 'linen' with the same consonants.
summary: A כֻּתֹּנֶת is a tunic worn on the body. In Genesis 3:21 Yahweh God makes tunics of skin for Adam and his wife and clothes them.

senses.definition: A garment worn on the body.

evidence.note: כָּתְנוֹת עוֹר names the tunics of skin that Yahweh God makes for Adam and his wife. The following verb וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם says that he clothed them.
